entry.note: the caller's **kwargs are forwarded unchanged to git checkout-index, e.g. index.checkout(prefix='/abs/dir/', force=True); the kwarg key names the option and its value is the output path

guards.note: unless allow_unsafe_options=True, Git.check_unsafe_options(Git._option_candidates([], kwargs), unsafe_git_checkout_index_options=['--prefix']) raises UnsafeOptionError before git runs, for prefix=..., abbreviations such as pre=/prefi=, list values, a key like 'prefix=<dir>', and a split single-char value such as u='--prefix=<dir>'

sinks.note: self.repo.git.checkout_index(*args, **kwargs) -> Git.__getattr__ -> _call_process -> transform_kwargs/transform_kwarg emit --prefix=<caller path>; self.execute(call) Popens 'git checkout-index --prefix=<path> --index [--force] --all', which writes every index blob under the caller-chosen absolute path (with --force, overwriting existing files)

notes: Pilot spec, reviewed at 2.3 and kept; re-reviewed 2026-09-28 (flow, slice and class unchanged, notes extended). Class: path-traversal by impact (caller-chosen output directory for git checkout-index, CWE-22/CWE-73 per the advisory); the mechanism is option injection into git's argv (CWE-88 style), as in the other GitPython events. Flow chosen: Instance 1 of the advisory (IndexFile.checkout -> git checkout-index --prefix, arbitrary file write). The fix commit also guards TagReference.create (git tag -F/--file, arbitrary read), but that half is known-incomplete at the clean commit (positional path/reference bypass, e.g. reference='--file=<path>', and joined short options with split_single_char_options=False; closed later by GHSA-3wxw-xv34-2frg / 1b0d2d9b and GHSA-wvpp-8hx9-p66j / 96a888f4), so git/refs/tag.py is left out of the slice and regression.diff carries only the checkout hunks. The checkout-index kwargs path is closed by this commit. Verified concretely: GitPython's own helpers (dashify, _option_candidates, _canonicalize_option_name, check_unsafe_options, transform_kwarg(s), _unpack_args, execute_kwargs) were extracted from git/cmd.py (byte-identical at both commits), and the argv that IndexFile.checkout(paths=None, force=True, **kw) builds was run with real git 2.55 in a scratch repo. At 07e80555, prefix=<dir>/, pre=, prefi= and u='--prefix=<dir>/' all reach git and overwrite a pre-existing f.txt outside the repo with the indexed blob (rc 0), and **{'prefix=<dir>/': True} also writes outside the repo (to the dashified path); at 3af0c251 the added guard raises UnsafeOptionError for every one of them. The two spellings the guard lets through do not reach the option: u='--prefix=...' with split_single_char_options=False becomes '-u--prefix=...' and p=<dir> becomes '-p <dir>', both rejected by git (rc 129). --prefix has no short form, and explicit paths go to git over stdin, never argv. Re-checked 2026-09-28 with git 2.55.0.windows.3 (same helper extraction, scratch repo): prefix=, pre=, prefi=, u='--prefix=...' (split), prefix=[<dir>/] and the key form 'prefix=<dir>/' all reach git and write outside the repo with the guard absent, and the clean guard raises UnsafeOptionError for each; a benign q=True passes the guard. git also accepts '--prefix <string>' as two tokens, but kwargs always become one '--name=value' token and checkout's positional args are fixed, so that form is unreachable here. The GHSA-wvpp joined-short-option bypass (split_single_char_options=False) does not reach --prefix for checkout-index because no short option of checkout-index takes a path. Scope follows the true sink: entry and guard are in git/index/base.py, the Popen is in git/cmd.py::Git.execute (about 350 lines, recorded as true_symbol; its nearest in-slice call site is Git._call_process). Accepted dropped references: Git.execute (true sink, too large); _AutoInterrupt/_CatFileContentStream (type aliases for the process wrapper, not on the option path); _GitMeta (metaclass); execute_kwargs and Git._unpack_args (trimmed to stay under 24 KB, the slice is at 24.0 KB: execute_kwargs only diverts as_process/istream/env and the like to execute, and _unpack_args flattens GitPython's own fixed positional args, not the caller's kwargs); IndexFile._to_relative_path/_write_path_to_stdin/_flush_stdin_and_wait (feed explicit paths over stdin in the paths branch; the options reach git identically in both branches and the paths=None branch shows the whole flow). The hop self.repo.git.checkout_index -> Git.__getattr__ is dynamic dispatch through Repo.git (git/repo/base.py, not in the slice; IndexFile.__init__, which types self.repo as Repo, is also cut for size). The @default_index decorator (git/index/util.py, imported, not sliced) only asserts the index is the repository's default index and does not touch kwargs. Not modelled, and not closed by this commit or named in the advisory: env={'GIT_WORK_TREE': <dir>} passed to IndexFile.checkout is an execute kwarg (diverted by _call_process, merged into the Popen environment by Git.execute), and with it git checkout-index --all --force writes outside the repo (checked with git 2.55); it is an environment channel, not option injection. Reviewers disagreed on scope (confirm: local, refute: cross-file); the pre-registered rule gives cross_file because the subprocess call is in git/cmd.py.

clean.text: # This option allows arbitrary command execution in git-ls-remote.

Some options passed to ``git <command>`` can execute arbitrary commands and
        are therefore blocked by default unless the caller explicitly allows them.
